owns: Local Administrator authentication trust boundary and credential-lifecycle separation
live-data encryption-key authority boundary and Windows-protected key ownership
does_not_own: SQLite schema, migration sequencing, repositories or transaction implementation — HLD-02/HLD-14
domain command authorization semantics beyond the single-admin installation model — owning HLD modules
domain audit event meaning/history projection — HLD-14
workbook/PST semantic validation — HLD-05/HLD-10, while HLD-13 supplies security constraints
device credential storage or SSH — excluded from Beta 1.0
exact cryptographic algorithms/parameters/Windows API calls — LLD

trust_zones.rule: Only the verified SOMA host owning the canonical data instance may mutate operational truth.
Browser requests are untrusted input despite loopback origin and must pass run/session/anti-forgery validation.
Workbook, PST/OST, MSG and backup files are untrusted until their owning validation/verification contracts succeed.
Non-authoritative outputs receive only minimized sanitized allowlisted context and never secrets/body-equivalent content.
